source: Two user supplied creature references, 2026-09-30; exact fidelity requires visual review, not assumed.

requests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production game cutout of EXACTLY the same long-horned HELLHOUND creature in the two user-provided photographs, not a redesign. The photos are creature design references only; omit all display stands, cables, floorboards, supports, backgrounds and photographic overlays. One creature only, complete body viewed in a readable strict side-profile facing RIGHT, neutral alert stance on all FOUR feet, head held low and forward. Preserve its distinctive long low elongated muscular quadruped silhouette, huge blocky forelimbs, powerful hindlimbs, short tail, mottled ochre-orange and desaturated sage/teal crocodilian polygonal scales. Closely preserve the head: tiny visible pale eye, short snout, broad jaw showing teeth, several exceptionally LONG narrow ivory horns projecting FORWARD above and beside the head, and huge thin ivory cheek tusks sweeping downward then far forward. A sparse row of tall tapered ivory dorsal spines rises from upper shoulders and back, accompanied by many very thin extended bristle/whisker filaments that stretch backward, as in the references. Do NOT substitute the dense swept-back crest of the previous blue-green Hound, no new rhinoceros horn, no huge humanoid mandibles, no dreadlocks, no ears, no fur, no extra legs, no hands. Match the supplied design as closely as possible in anatomy, proportions, palette and horn placement. Crisp detailed painterly game sprite, natural even illumination, no aura, no outline. Actual transparent alpha background. Use a wide landscape canvas, complete creature including the longest horns and hairlike filaments comfortably inside the frame, at least 10 percent transparent padding on ALL sides, absolutely no cropping. Ground contact aligned, no baked floor or cast shadow. Single whole-body sprite, not a collage, not an animation sheet, no text.
